data.name: 斗罗大陆：猎魂世界
data.detailed_description:
The first 3D realistic open-world MMORPG of the 斗罗大陆：猎魂世界 – is now spectacularly launched!

Authorized by both the original novel and anime series, it’s time to redefine the boundless world of Douluo! International action icon Jackie Chan crosses boundaries to serve as its spokesperson, embodying the authentic aesthetics of combat. Come to Douluo and explore the all-new Soul Hunt World alongside Jackie Chan! Your Douluo dream – the action legend is here to share the journey with you!

This is a genuine Douluo MMO in every sense of the word. We aim to build brand-new memories of Douluo Continent for a new generation through this game. We hope this title, three years in the making, will bring you a more thrilling and realistic Douluo Continent.

Game Features

  • A True Douluo Open WorldUnlimited freedom in an all-new open world! From the soul beast-infested Star Dou Great Forest to the surging waves of Sea God Island, you can interact with the map and explore the open world freely. The Douluo world is yours to roam!

  • Real-time, Dynamic CombatAuthentic, hard-hitting real-time battles! We deeply recreate the combat experience from the original Douluo works, with customizable controls and non-targeted combat. Immerse yourself in heart-pounding, smooth combo action!

  • Seamless Switch Between Multiple Spirit WuhunsAuthentic Spirit Wuhuns with seamless switching! Experience the unique Spirit Master combat system, customize your soul skill combinations, and unleash attacks in turn with assault, agility, control, and support-type Wuhuns to turn the tide of battle in an instant.

  • Animation-level Faithful RestorationAuthentic restoration with top-tier Douluo quality! Authorized by both the anime and novel, it boasts high-precision character models and plot presentations that stay true to the original work. Relive the memories of Xiao Wu, Tang San, and other beloved characters, and encounter brand-new stories on your journey of trials to become a god.
